npcs.name: Nessa Kell
facts: The well turned bitter nine days ago; the well-head lamps will not relight.
Gallows Knoll opened beneath a ram nine days ago.
Tallow Hold was built by lamp-keepers; the Ember Lamp keeps something quiet below.
Nessa pays 20 gp now and 60 gp on return.

npcs.name: Tobren Vask
npcs.role: Surveyor trapped in the Chapel of Wicks
facts: The six Chapel wicks must be lit from low to high.
Tobren knows the Level 2 layout.
The winch chain is greased despite being unused for a century.
The goblin boss wears a stolen breastplate.

npcs.name: Pip Ashgrub
facts: Skarrik keeps the Cinderwick key on a cord around his neck.
The old ward keeps goblins out of the Tallow Larder.
The boss hall has a back door.
The smoke people grease the shaft chain each dusk.

locations.name: Marrowfell
facts: Marrowfell has one stone well and about 120 residents.
The well water turned bitter nine days ago.

locations.name: Gallows Knoll
facts: A sinkhole opened here nine days before the story starts.

locations.name: Tallow Hold
facts: The extinct lamp-keepers built this three-level keep: Upper Ruins, Cinderwick Warrens, and Lamp Vault.
The one-way winch shaft descends; the rear stair opens after the lamp choice.

locations.name: The Ember Lamp
facts: The lamp binds the dead and keeps the spring sweet.
Relighting it cleans the well in three days and settles the wardens.
Smothering it frees the dead and the well never recovers.

quests.note: Restore the well by resolving the Ember Lamp choice.
